structured_output.summary: KIP-1066 implemented across config, protocol, LogManager/ReplicaManager, heartbeat, controller storage/placement, MV gating, DescribeLogDirs and the log dirs tool. CordonedLogDirsIntegrationTest (3 tests on embedded KRaft clusters) passes. Only :server tests could be run, so other modules' existing suites were not run. Deviations: (1) DescribeLogDirsRequest.json is not in the file list, so IsCordoned was added to the DescribeLogDirs response as an ignorable tagged field on existing version 4 instead of a v5 bump; (2) cordoned dirs are not persisted in metadata snapshots (RegisterBrokerRecord.json is not listed): they are carried by BrokerRegistrationChangeRecord v3 and re-reported by every broker heartbeat, so they are restored within one heartbeat after snapshot load or re-registration.

criteria_notes.note: CordonedLogDirsIntegrationTest.testCordonedLogDirIsNotUsedForNewReplicas: dynamic SET of cordoned.log.dirs on a broker works, '/not/a/log/dir' is rejected (InvalidRequestException), DELETE uncordons; testCordonedBrokersAreNotUsedForNewPartitions covers '*' and removal.
CordonedLogDirsIntegrationTest.testCordoningRequiresMetadataVersion (4.2-IV1): dynamic set fails with InvalidConfigurationException; static '*' leaves all dirs un-cordoned and topic creation works.

testCordonedBrokersAreNotUsedForNewPartitions and testCordonedLogDirIsNotUsedForNewReplicas wait until the controller-committed registration (seen in broker metadata image) shows the cordoned dirs after a dynamic change, and shows them removed after uncordoning, without restarts.

testCordonedBrokersAreNotUsedForNewPartitions: auto-placed topic and added partitions avoid cordoned broker 0; RF 3 with broker 0 cordoned fails with InvalidReplicationFactorException; after uncordoning RF 3 succeeds.
testCordonedBrokersAreNotUsedForNewPartitions: explicit assignment in createTopics and createPartitions onto broker 0 fails with InvalidReplicaAssignmentException.
testCordonedBrokersAreNotUsedForNewPartitions: alterPartitionReassignments adding broker 0 fails with IneligibleReplicaException, while a reassignment keeping an existing broker-0 replica succeeds.
testCordonedLogDirIsNotUsedForNewReplicas: alterReplicaLogDirs to the cordoned dir fails with InvalidReplicaAssignmentException and succeeds after uncordoning.

testCordonedLogDirIsNotUsedForNewReplicas: new partitions all land in the uncordoned dir, and LogManager.getOrCreateLog with the cordoned dir id as the suggested target creates the log in the uncordoned dir.

LogDirDescription.isCordoned() asserted via Admin describeLogDirs in the integration tests (true/false per dir, via a tagged field on DescribeLogDirsResponse v4). The LogDirsCommand 'isCordoned' output is added but untested (tools module not on the server test classpath).

testCordonedLogDirIsNotUsedForNewReplicas reads kafka.log:type=LogManager LogDirectoryCordoned per dir (1/0) and CordonedLogDirectoryCount (1 then 0) from the Yammer registry; gauges are removed on LogManager shutdown.
CordonedLogDirsIntegrationTest (3 @ClusterTest tests on embedded KRaft clusters) passes.
